newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabian shares mixed in improved trade.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabian shares mixed in improved trade.

text.p: Shares on the Saudi Arabian stock exchange ended last week mixed in improved trade focused on banking and industrial sector shares, figures from the Riyadh-based Bakheet Financial Advisors (BFA) showed on Sunday.
The index ended 1.82 percent higher at 148.42 points from the previous week's 145.77 points.
BFA said cement shares accounted for 34 percent of trading volume put at about 7.3 million shares. Trading value rose to 1.6 million riyals ($426 million) from 941.05 million riyals a week earlier.
Of the 60 companies traded, share prices of 35 rose, 15 fell and 10 were unchanged, BFA said.

Among major gainers in the week were Arab Cement which ended nine percent higher at 157 riyals from a previous 144 riyals and Saudi American Bank which closed 8.2 percent stronger at 544 riyals from 503 million riyals.
